classificationNotes: Source-draft Elementals are treated as magical entities whose temporary bodies take on unaffiliated spell-matter or one of the four base affinities. This is a visual and encounter-production family, not an accepted claim about origin, life, cognition, agency, personhood, summoning, or hostility. A flame-like outer contour describes shape and motion only; it does not imply Fire affinity.
visualConstants: Every form is organized around one readable binding seed or core, with no flesh, worn armor, ordinary clothing, handheld weapon, or fixed face.
The T1 Wisp is a small asymmetric teardrop or flame-like shape without limbs; T2–T5 develop a legless hovering upper body with exactly two coherent arm channels and a tapering lower body.
Affinity substance forms the complete load-bearing body, limbs, mantle, and directional wake rather than appearing as a colored exterior aura or decorative overlay.
Form coherence, core structure, and spatial control progress from one wandering Wisp to a four-facet Sovereign while the active telegraph and exposed counterplay remain readable.
escalationAxis: Form coherence, core complexity, and control over shaped affinity substance rise from one drifting teardrop to a sovereign that transforms the arena through four learned binding patterns.

constructionDimensions: Unaffiliated forms use desaturated silver-grey, softly translucent neutral spell-matter folded inward around a matte charcoal binding seed or core.
Motion remains smooth, quiet, and self-contained, leaving only a brief colorless distortion with no elemental particles, status cue, or environmental residue.
normal.counterplaySignal: The charcoal seed, channel gap, core ring, mantle shutter, or sovereign facet dulls after the form commits to its family mechanic.
forbidden: Affinity-coded body colour or material
Elemental status or environmental wake
Radiant halo or void-like absence
Featureless orb without the form's declared silhouette

constructionDimensions: Vermilion living combustion, a yellow-hot inner seam, controlled ember grain, black exhaust markers, and restrained heat distortion form the complete body.
The body expands and curls upward during motion; higher forms route combustion through their established channels, mantle sections, and core facets without acquiring extra anatomy.
fire.counterplaySignal: The active throat, channel, mantle shutter, or core facet turns pale and exhausts to black immediately after ignition, exposing the established opening.
forbidden: Uniform orange glow without material structure
Fire pasted over a neutral body
Premature high-tier mantle or facet anatomy
Magma, lightning, or another dual-affinity material

constructionDimensions: Ochre-brown and umber earth magic forms the complete body from circulating soil, clay, silt, and fine mineral grains held in the family's flame-like contours.

Motion compresses, folds, and settles downward; load-bearing mineral seams and restrained pale-ochre faults articulate channels, mantle sections, and core facets without turning the form into a Golem.
earth.counterplaySignal: A loaded seam compacts, hairline faults spread, and the seed, channel gap, mantle shutter, or sovereign facet loosens after the committed action.
forbidden: Red or yellow combustion
Embers, smoke, char, lava, or molten rock
A solid rock projectile or ordinary masonry body
Brown palette without earthen material behavior

constructionDimensions: Pale green-grey compressed air, translucent pressure sheets, directional ribbons, and thin shear edges form the complete body around a clear still core.
Motion stretches laterally and spirals through aligned channels, vanes, mantle planes, and facets while visible debris vectors remain sparse and local.
wind.counterplaySignal: The still core or channel gap becomes sharply clear when the surrounding pressure body commits to a drift, sweep, convergence, or arena pattern.
forbidden: Lightning or electrical arcs
Cloud body without load-bearing pressure structure
Directionless fog
Pale recolour without aerodynamic motion

constructionDimensions: Deep-blue cohesive liquid, surface-tension membranes, circulating current lines, droplets, and pressure rings form the complete body around a dense clear core.
Motion pours upward through the flame-like family contour and returns through visible channels, mantle shells, and core facets without becoming ice or shapeless mist.
water.counterplaySignal: A pressure ring expands and the seed, return channel, drainage shutter, or core facet clears when the committed flow briefly loses pressure.
forbidden: Ice or frost anatomy
Shapeless mist without a liquid circuit
Water pasted over a neutral body
Blue palette without cohesive fluid behavior

forms.battlefieldDuty: Probe movement with one small airborne entity that commits to a visibly prepared destination.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the Wisp's tapered tail and a gathering eddy reveal its next drift before the core moves.
forms.signatureMechanic: Trace Drift: the Wisp curls its lower tail toward a small gathering eddy, glides to that point as one continuous creature, and briefly dims on arrival.
forms.telegraph: The asymmetric teardrop leans, its pointed crest bends, and its continuous lower tail curls toward the forming eddy.
forms.counterplay: Leave the gathering eddy, follow behind the completed drift, and strike the dimmed binding seed before the body recovers.
forms.visualDelta: Palm-sized asymmetric teardrop or flame-like entity with one visible seed, a pointed crest, a continuous tapering tail, no face, no limbs, and no projectile trail.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Apply repeatable mid-range pressure with one committed arm channel.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the extended arm remains committed while the opposite side of the single core is exposed.
forms.signatureMechanic: Tether Reach: one arm channel lengthens across a marked lane while the compact torso and opposite arm hold the binding core in place.
forms.telegraph: The legless upper body narrows, one arm thins into a taut tether, and the core shifts visibly away from it.
forms.counterplay: Cross behind the extending tether and strike the exposed side of the core before the arm retracts.
forms.visualDelta: Human-sized faceless hovering torso with exactly two tapering arms, one central seed-core, and a legless lower body dissolving into a continuous tail.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Wisps drift toward the tether endpoint; crossing behind the committed arm separates them from the Spirit.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Qualitatively pivot into a lane controller whose two arm channels alternate between sweep and guard.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the attacking conduit fixes one lane while the opposite guard leaves one edge of the ring core exposed.
forms.signatureMechanic: Twin Conduit: one arm becomes a sweeping affinity channel while the other compacts into a guard; the two roles reverse after every sweep.
forms.telegraph: One conduit straightens toward the marked lane, the opposite arm folds inward, and one side of the ring core becomes visible.
forms.counterplay: Enter behind the sweeping conduit and strike the exposed ring edge before the two arms reverse.
forms.visualDelta: Fully coherent hovering upper body with exactly two strong arm conduits, a divided ring core, broad shoulders, and a narrow tapering lower body.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Elemental Spirits hold the guarded lane with Tether Reach; interrupting their tether opens the Warden's core flank.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Control encounter space by shifting three articulated mantle sections between a barrier and converging marked lanes.
forms.teachingGoal: Teach that the core shutter is visible only while the three mantle sections widen and change formation.
forms.signatureMechanic: Mantle Orbit: three affinity-built mantle sections widen into a barrier ring, expose the central shutter, and then converge through three marked lanes.
forms.telegraph: The broad hovering body stills, three mantle sections separate along visible seams, and the central shutter turns toward the open gap.
forms.counterplay: Cross a widening mantle gap and strike the exposed shutter before the three sections converge.
forms.visualDelta: Large broad floating upper body with exactly two integrated arms, three articulated mantle sections, a shuttered core, and no feet, worn armor, or independent rock anatomy.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Elemental Wardens feed one conduit into each mantle lane; breaking the linked ring edge leaves that mantle gap open.

forms.battlefieldDuty: Transform the arena through four binding patterns that recombine every lower-form lesson.
forms.teachingGoal: Test drift destinations, committed tethers, alternating conduits, and mantle gaps as permanent stages of one authored boss encounter.
forms.signatureMechanic: Arena Transformation — Fourfold Lattice: four core facets successively invoke Trace Drift, Tether Reach, Twin Conduit, and Mantle Orbit; resolving a pattern permanently dims its facet and weakens the final lattice.
forms.telegraph: One of four core facets turns outward, its matching orbital vane aligns with the arena, and the lower-form silhouette appears within the selected path.
forms.counterplay: Resolve the announced lower-form lesson and strike the outward-facing facet; every dimmed facet removes one pattern from the final transformation.
forms.visualDelta: Tall complete hovering figure with exactly two coherent arms, a four-facet central core, four orbital vanes, a tapering lower body, and an affinity-built arena wake.
forms.lowerFormInteraction: Wisp, Elemental Spirit, Elemental Warden, and Elemental Colossus each govern one facet; solving that form's counterplay permanently disables its lattice pattern.
